newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 continues to slide, no rebound seen.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 continues to slide, no rebound seen.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index continued to decline on Friday despite a late rally from SPT Telecom during continuous trading.
The PX50 closed down four points to 543.2 brushing asside a 25 crown gain to 3,350 from SPT which dealers said was built on low volumes.
CEZ fell five crowns to 1,025, Komercni Banka lost 20 crowns to 2,330 and IPB dropped 14 crowns to 315.
"We will probably keep going down because in order to go up you need foreign investors," said Jan Sykora of Wood and Company.
"If we have CEZ at around 950 again or SPT below 3,000, or Komercni at 2,000 I think people will start looking at some of the stocks again," he added.

IPB Bank moved in similar fashion to yesterday on continued speculation about the company's results. Despite another strong denial from the bank that its 1996 results would show heavy losses, IPB was down sharply for most of the session.
Right at the end of continuous trading, IPB recovered to close down 14 crowns to 315. The bank said that it would release its audited results either on Friday or Monday.
